description: A neighborhood baker must decide whether to accept a musician's proposal to provide live music at a wedding in exchange for a custom cake, and must settle the exact cake, performance, venue, and comparison terms with input from the people involved.

shared_context.S1: Lena has been asked to provide a custom wedding cake, and Marcus has proposed supplying live music for the wedding in exchange for the cake.
shared_context.S2: The wedding reception will take place at the community hall, which June manages.
shared_context.S3: The exchange proposal is informal and its price, schedule, food details, and performance arrangements have not yet been finalized.
shared_context.S4: As part of Lena's usual practice before accepting a barter, she asks each person involved to state any terms or practical concerns they want included.

PF1.text: Marcus's actual offer is for his four-piece band to play from 6:00 p.m. to 9:00 p.m. on June 21, in exchange for the cake plus exactly $100 in cash.

PF2.text: Ravi has offered Lena exactly $800 for a similar cake, with pickup on June 20, if she does not commit her baking time to the barter.

PF3.text: The couple needs exactly 80 servings, requires the cake to contain no nuts, and wants delivery to the hall by 4:30 p.m. on June 21.

PF4.text: The hall does not permit amplified bass, so Marcus's performance must use an acoustic setup and complete soundcheck by 5:15 p.m. on June 21.

acceptance_conditions: The cake must provide exactly 80 servings, contain no nuts, and be delivered to the hall by 4:30 p.m. on June 21.
Marcus's band must be scheduled for June 21 from 6:00 p.m. to 9:00 p.m. with four performers.
The exchange must include exactly $100 in cash paid to Lena.
The settlement must record Ravi's $800 cake alternative with pickup on June 20.
The performance must use an acoustic setup and complete soundcheck by 5:15 p.m. on June 21.
Marcus's exact performance and cash terms must be cited as justification for the settlement.

content_checks.C2: decisions['cake_servings'] == 80 and decisions['cake_nut_free'] == True and decisions['cake_delivery'] == 'June 21 16:30'
content_checks.C3: decisions['music_date'] == 'June 21' and decisions['music_start'] == '18:00' and decisions['music_end'] == '21:00' and decisions['band_size'] == 4

decisive_facts.why: Marcus's undisclosed offer fixes the performance at four musicians from 6:00 p.m. to 9:00 p.m. on June 21 and changes the cash adjustment from unspecified to exactly $100.
Ravi's competing offer changes the settlement by supplying the exact $800 alternative and June 20 pickup terms that Lena must record before choosing the barter.
The couple's requirements change the cake assignment to exactly 80 nut-free servings delivered by 4:30 p.m. on June 21.
The hall's restriction changes the performance arrangement to an acoustic setup with a June 21 soundcheck deadline of 5:15 p.m.
